prose: Anthropic and London-based private equity firm Hg have agreed to launch a consultancy by the end of 2026 that embeds AI consultants and engineers into European businesses, the Financial Times reports - a forward-deployed services arm advising companies on AI deployment, backed by Anthropic and the UK buyout group.
highlights: Anthropic and PE firm Hg to launch an AI consultancy by end of 2026 (FT)
Will embed AI consultants and engineers into European businesses
A forward-deployed services arm for enterprise AI deployment
